P1.1.title: Fix camera stretch + getUserMedia HD quality
P1.1.notes: Removed dynamic aspect-ratio on camera-zone. Enforced object-fit:cover !important. HD getUserMedia already in place via PERF profiles.

P1.2.title: Camera centered between buttons (toggle setting)
P1.2.notes: Added cameraFraming toggle in Settings > Appearance. body[data-camera-framing=centered] adds bottom margin + rounded corners.

P1.3.title: Filter-rail rewrite (rotation + inertia + snap)
P1.3.notes: Added wheel event handler with momentum-based inertia (damping 0.85, cap ±8, 600ms timeout). Snap to nearest filter on inertia end.

P1.4.title: Phototheque responsive (phone QR bottom sheet)
P1.4.notes: Added @media (max-width: 767px) to make gallery-qr-hero a fixed bottom sheet with blur backdrop. Tablet keeps sticky sidebar.

P1.5.title: Gallery pagination pills (où je suis)
P1.5.notes: Added gallery-pills container with numbered pills, active state, click-to-jump. Max 40 pills with step calculation. No changes to existing carousel v125.0.0.

P1.6.title: Export redesign (1 drawer button)
P1.6.notes: Replaced share-chip icon grid with single drawer trigger button. Bottom drawer slides up with 7 options. 3-col grid on phone, 6-col on tablet.
